title: Epiphany during Jean Houston's mystery school lecture on The Cipher of Genesis

tellings.quote: somehow as I'm listening to this lecture, I got it. And I had the experience of how it happened, how God created this universe.

plain: The parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove says that while he listened to a lecture on The Cipher of Genesis, a book by Carlos Suares, at the "mystery school" run by the teacher Jean Houston, he suddenly "got it" and had "the experience of how it happened, how God created this universe." Mishlove tells it as his own experience, and also mentions Robert Masters, who wrote the book Varieties of Psychedelic Experience with Houston. For him it is a moment when an old text about creation became something he felt directly.
